title: D5: replace location.replace document-swap stubs with same-document entry-aliases (mode preselected)
description: Document swap on internal nav destroys session/FS-Access state. Legacy public/tools/*.html become entry-aliases booting the merged app with mode preselected (#mode); internal mode switching is an in-app view swap, zero navigation. Keep vite inputs; re-point e2e in same milestone.

title: ForgeTool signatures non-uniform; use dedicated ToolMode lifecycle for shell, keep ForgeTool strictly in-game
description: attachDevTools.ts:23-31 shows three different construction signatures; ForgeTool is an overlay-over-game-canvas contract. Gate: no attachDevTools.ts change + no tool constructor-signature churn in the same milestone (forge-tools-e2e/xtractor-forge-e2e depend on in-game Forge windows).
author: Dave

title: Packaging: pngjs must move to @small-world-machine/tools prod-deps; swm smoke gate; --json schema/exit codes versioned
description: pngjs is root devDep today; tsx bins escape all gates. Conditions: pngjs to tools dependencies, clean-install smoke, swm --help + one canned run in gates, --json schema/exit-code changes versioned + CHANGELOG-noted (automation contract).
author: Dave

title: D2/D3: define RasterIO/ImageCodec interface in core now; determinism on RGBA fixtures, not PNG bytes
description: Browser Image decode != pngjs decode (colorspace/gamma/premultiply) => shared-core web/CLI byte divergence. Route BOTH surfaces through RasterIO (browser adapter + pngjs adapter); golden web<->CLI parity tests on derived maps/sprite detection; determinism asserted on pre-decoded RGBA fixtures.
author: Bob

title: Domain model: ADR 0010 section 3/4 amend + 'Project/Workspace' term in CONTEXT.md required
description: Shared project folder re-negotiates Maker FS-Access autosave semantics; CONTEXT.md has no Project/Workspace concept today. Must land as ADR-A amendment + CONTEXT.md term before shared-workspace feature.
author: Dave

title: Final Big-Merge decisions D1-D6 as amended (all critique conditions F1-F6 folded in)
description: D1: Maker host shell via dedicated ToolMode lifecycle (no ForgeTool reuse in shell; ForgeTool stays in-game). D2: headless core = pure ops slices + shared core/pipeline, boundary rules incl. RasterIO interface (F5), MapGenerator.loadFromImage purge + grep gate (F1). D3: pure-TS-first + pngjs (to tools prod-dep, F4), headless-Chrome only for IBL, PNG-first, .gltf-only Phase A. D4: single swm umbrella, --json/exit codes versioned (F4). D5: phased M1-M6, same-document entry-aliases (F2), kit/spatter scope per D6, domain amend (F6). D6: Kit Inspector deferred mode + swm kit validate first, SplatterCore CLI-only + standalone page, Gamepad separate, Forge in-game-only.
author: Alice
